extras.price_arithmetic: the page prints EUR 8.26 a month and EUR 9.50 '(incl. 19% VAT)'; the contract term is 12 months. The two figures do not reconcile at 19 per cent: 8.26 x 1.19 = 9.83, and 9.50 / 8.26 implies 15.01 per cent. All five plans on the page show the same 1.150 ratio, so the label and the arithmetic disagree by a constant, not by a typo in one row. Both figures are quoted as printed; the rate the page used is not derived here
extras.currency_note: the page prints EUR only; the USD figure here uses the page's own VAT-inclusive EUR amount and is not a converted rate
